uniequip_002_blkkgt:
Among Degenbrecher's luggage is a case exclusively for storing her medals. After making exceedingly short work of her operator exam, the remaining downtime was spent with her enlightening our HR operators as to their significance.
- Knight-Champion of Kazimierz Medal
Black medal of crossed swordbreakers, lying unassumingly in center of case. Design makes it immediately clear that Kazimierz tailored this champion's medal to her. She reigned for three straight years and so was given three, but only the first was personally awarded to her by the Grand Knight after usurping the defender. Which is why she didn't throw it away, and why it's the one artifact of Kazimierz she still carries with her.
'Commemorative enough, barely.'
- 'Thanks'
Inverted triangle inscribed with Kjerag's holy Mount Karlan. Not issued by any official organization, rather forged for her by clan head Ratatos at the request of a household under Browntail rule. Degenbrecher had rescued said household's members from an avalanche.
'This first one was almost ten years ago now. I know they meant it nicely, and I don't mind how it looks. But the news spread, and now I get one of these medals from the Tri-Clans any time I do something similar. The cupboard at home is full of them.'
- 'The Silverashes' Sword and Shield'
Second medal from the left, sword and shield motif. All of Karlan Trade knows that those wearing this medal are free to act unimpeded wherever Karlan Trade is concerned. Initially a pass designed expressly for her by Enciodes, but as soon became apparent, nobody simply overlooks the presence of Degenbrecher. Its worth these days is instead in gently reminding others that she is affiliated with Karlan Trade.
'One day, I forgot to wear this one. Enciodes went that entire day quieter than usual, then in the end asked if I had any complaints with the company.'
- 'Kjeragandr's Soldier'
Third medal, honorary decoration issued by the Vine-Bead Court, was worn by Enya herself when she formally became the Saintess.
'This was the biggest protest the Saintess could make back then. I don't think much in particular about Kjeragandr—at most, I think I'd like to take Her on.'
- '10 Years'
To mark ten years of acquaintance, Enciodes rustled up a little gift for her, effectively commemorating her Karlan Trade decennial at the same time. It may not have been founded when they first met, but the blueprints were already laid out in his heart.
'I didn't even recall what it was commemorating when he gave me this. A token of thanks, I suppose, but I'm sure he just wanted to let me know that he still remembered the big words he said back when it all began. Speaking of Kjerag... if you're ever there as a tourist and want to find somewhere quiet, you can ask me.'
uniequip_003_blkkgt:
'You're late, Black Knight. How unusual.'
The new president of Karlan Trade smiles at Degenbrecher as she walks into his office. He is fiddling with something in his hand.
'I was told that you're renewing my contract, Gnosis.'
'Yes. The documents are on the table. However—' He pauses. 'Did you see the new motorcycle outside?
'Karlan Trade is finally starting to produce its own motorcycles. Made entirely domestically, and able to operate reliably at minus 20 degrees, something that no other country has achieved.'
'Yes. It was hard to miss.'
Degenbrecher strides over to the right side of the room, where a display cabinet was recently installed by the new president.
Inside is a cracked bearing, from the drilling machine that broke down when they first tried digging for ore samples in Kjerag. Enciodes had insisted on keeping it as a souvenir after Degenbrecher pulled him out of the hole, his face covered in dust.
'There used to be a portrait of Enciodes here, if I recall correctly.' Degenbrecher says as she gestures at the location.
'I took it down. How would YOU feel if you got a late-night message about work while his face was staring at you?'
'I see... thanks, Gnosis.'
'There's something else that will make you even happier.' Gnosis seems unusually excited. 'We're planning ice fishing activities targeted at tourists, for which we've developed smart fishing rods that assist the user in reeling in the catch. I heard that you used to—'
'Gnosis.' She does not raise her voice, but her tone is cold as ice.
'...I'm sorry. I just heard rumors.'
'All you need to know is that it's all in the past.'
The silence lingers between them.
'It just so happens that I have a present for you. Let it serve as an apology.' Gnosis stands up and gives Degenbrecher the object he had been holding.
It is a black motorcycle key, with the Karlan Trade emblem on it.
'It's an upgrade over your current ride, and we had it painted red and black for you.' Gnosis smiles. 'I discussed it with Enciodes, and the staff agreed unanimously:
'You deserve to get the first ever motorcycle manufactured by Karlan Trade.'
Degenbrecher's lips twitch, but she says nothing, only touching the emblem lightly with her thumb.
'Thanks.'
She turns around and walks towards the door.
'Wait,' Gnosis calls out to her. 'You haven't signed the—'
'No need to.'
Degenbrecher does not turn around.
'I'm staying here.' She puts a finger through the keychain ring, and lifts it up beside her ear.
'If there comes a day when our paths diverge—' Her tone is calm and matter-of-fact, like reading out the terms of a contract. 'I'll ride this away as payment for my years of service.'
The door is pulled open. Cold wind blows into the office, rustling the papers on the desk.
Gnosis mutters softly, the words disappearing into the wind:
'As you wish.'
